note: Research pre-registration, NOT a runnable FactorMiner config. The CLI does not read this file. Its purpose is to freeze the universe / cost / trial-family choices BEFORE any experiment so they cannot be chosen after seeing results. Once committed to git, changes require a new plan_id.
objective: Cross-sectional multi-factor portfolio over a few hundred crypto perpetual pairs, with promotion decided only by the existing gate layer (BH-FDR + DSR on real n_trials + empirical null + one-shot holdout).

universe.snapshot_caveat: 755 still-listed contracts as of 2026-11-15; delisted contracts absent. All conclusions are EXPLORATORY until a delisting table exists.
universe.pit_policy: re-rank every bar by trailing-90-bar median quote volume (close*volume); asset eligible only after >=30 bars of history
universe.static_pools: FORBIDDEN for any headline result; forward-looking, kept only as a diagnostic contrast
universe.why_top60: only pool with stable positive net Sharpe across all three cost scenarios in the baseline (mom20 rb5: 0.743/0.669/0.668; mom60 rb5: 0.834/0.784/0.784)

cost.production_basis: core/experiment/costs.py must stop using a single global 18bp round-trip
cost.model: per-asset, per-bar round-trip = 2*(4bp taker fee + slip_i(t)); slip_i(t) = clip(5bp*sqrt(QV_top20_median(t)/QV_i(t)), 5bp, cap)
cost.identity_invariant: gate_cost_rate must equal the turnover-weighted effective cost; the existing gate == 2*(commission+slippage) identity must still hold under tiering
cost.caveat: square-root impact is a sensitivity assumption, not measured spread/impact

trial_family_rule: n_trials counted PER FAMILY, not globally. Different pool / horizon / paradigm are independent families. Budgets above are ceilings declared before seeing any result; exceeding requires a new plan_id.
rebalance_bars: MUST be re-measured under the PIT pool before changing from 1; the readiness report's '5-bar is 3x better' was measured on a fixed 20-coin pool and does not reproduce under pit_top60 (rb1 0.967 vs rb5 0.784).

gates.rule: No external IC / Sharpe feedback (Qlib, RD-Agent, skfolio, alphalens) may decide promotion.

preconditions_before_first_experiment: P0-A1 PIT pool definition landed + doctor check 'PIT pool declared' passing
P0-A2 tiered cost landed + gate identity invariant tested
P0-A3 per-asset coverage floor configurable as critical
P0-A4 N(t)-aware cross-sectional operators and reporting
trial family accounting in core/experiment/budget.py landed
baseline script re-run under PIT accounting with pit_top60 mom60 net Sharpe still > 0
acceptance: A factor is a result only if it passes apply_promotion_gates on the declared family and survives the one-shot holdout reveal. Net SR from the diagnostic baseline is NOT evidence of alpha (no multiple-testing correction, no DSR, no holdout, no funding cost).
